capabilities: Paint theme arcs on a two-ring 120-minute clock
Link segments to existing notes or create formatted title-card notes
Open linked notes in a side panel, tab, or current pane
Manage multiple projects stored as JSON in the vault
disambiguation: Not a writing timer; despite the clock name, it is a visual plotting board for story structure, not time tracking.
extras: Projects are stored as JSON inside .obsidian/plugins/story-clock/projects/ rather than as Markdown notes, so data lives in plugin config folders rather than the vault proper.
problem: Obsidian has no visual tool for plotting story structure, so writers cannot map themes and setup-payoff threads spatially next to their notes.

relations.evidence: The schema matches the standalone Circle Map — Story Clock desktop app, so a project can move freely between the two.
relations.plugin: Circle Map — Story Clock (standalone desktop app)

summary: Two-ring story clock that maps themes and setup-payoff arcs across a 120-minute timeline and links each segment to a vault note.
